actual_UP.theorem: Every coherent UP choice on an open one-step sector changes the primitive channel budget from the required class 1 to 2. Hence UP immediately leaves the one-step segment class before any full-turn closure question arises.

mandatory_user_M_UP.conditional_length_statement: If such a state were manually selected, its primitive budget would be 4, so it is even farther outside L_E=1.

first_divergence: Every open sector is already a competition fiber; coherent UP on the first sector produces an overbudget state. A completion operator that only fills missing budget cannot repair an overbudget state without changing from UP into a different contraction policy.
